newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ares-Serono raises 1996 net and dividend.
newsitem.headline: Ares-Serono raises 1996 net and dividend.

text.p: Ares-Serono Group said that its net income on 1996 results rose by 82 percent to $53.5 million from $29.4 million in 1995.
It also said that it was proposing raising its dividend on 1996 results to 2.00 Swiss francs from 1.20 previously per registered share.
It will also propose raising its dividend per bearer share to 5.00 francs from 3.00 francs previously.
Total net sales in 1996 rose by 18 percent to $805.0 million from $682.3 million. Sales were already announced on January 15.
The company said that it is also contemplating use of share capital to finance research and development projects in the U.S. and would also set up an employee stock option plan.
The proposals of the board will be submitted for approval by shareholders at the annual meeting to be held on June 17, 1997, it said.

"The maximum possible increase in shares outstanding would represent an increase of less than two percent of the number of total shares currently outstanding," Ares-Serono said with respect to the measure. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
